description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at 10 for different configurations of a Dense Retrieval with Document Expansion (DR-DE) system as the number of queries used during inference increases. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and ranges from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different configuration: "DRP w/o query" (black line with square markers and a solid line style), "DRP w/ gold" (green line with circle markers and a solid line style), "DRP w/ top-1" (blue line with diamond markers and a solid line style), "DRP w/ bottom-1" (purple line with triangle markers and a solid line style), "DRP w/ random" (yellow line with cross markers and a solid line style), and "DRP w/ curriculum" (red line with pentagon markers and a dashed line style). The "DRP w/ gold" line shows a steady increase in MRR as the number of queries increases, starting at approximately 35.5 and ending at around 36.5. The "DRP w/ top-1" line also shows an increase, starting at about 34.5 and ending near 35.5. The "DRP w/ bottom-1" line remains relatively flat, starting and ending at around 34.5. The "DRP w/ random" line shows a slight increase, starting at approximately 34.0 and ending just above 34.5. The "DRP w/ curriculum" line shows a slight decline, starting at around 35.0 and ending just below 35.0. The "DRP w/o query" line remains constant at 34.0 throughout the number of queries.
